scope: strategy historical observations, limited-sample reference estimates, traffic lap attribution

regressions.capture: DRS and 2026 overtake before/after timing, delayed active after fresh inactive, brief activation, bounded queue, reset epoch, immutable published flags
regressions.repository: legacy lap timings without fuel; track/game/race/ban/valid-lap scopes; exact fuel lap/time/tyre match, own count and null; latest 300 uploads and 150000 timing rows
regressions.analysis: one-user 12-race synthetic fixture with 324 usable laps returns two labelled reference plans; identical standard result, strict old-client default, duplicate/singular/missing-measurement/contaminated/sparse/pit/inventory guards
regressions.http: real authenticated HTTP and PostgreSQL legacy-only observation before new evidence, permissions/revocation and full simulation
regressions.browser: legacy observations despite empty contexts, optional metadata, server-negotiated limited request, fuel absent/count, bounded expandable table, one-user label, manual simulate and stale-response isolation

independent_review.pre_review: fresh context; no blockers after freshness/original-corpus/strict-fuel/minimum-copy refinements
independent_review.post_review: shared Flags backing array issue fixed by clone before append/sort, verified by immutable-snapshot regression

assumptions: Reference threshold of 1 user / 3 independent races / 12 retained clean laps is an initial product policy, not validated prediction accuracy.
limits: Production authenticated user records were not accessed.
Timing observations are not fuel/weather/traffic/pit adjusted.
Historical missing fuel is not reconstructed.
Reference plans still require identifiable model, adequate per-compound range, pit evidence and feasible inventory.
